items.question: I learned to swim. Do I say 我可以游泳 or 我會游泳?

LESSON_SIX_GRAMMAR_TWO.learnerPromise: Describe how well, fast, slowly, much, or happily an action is done.
LESSON_SIX_GRAMMAR_TWO.explanation: 得 joins an action to a report about it, like 跑得很快. Keep the action word right before 得. For a two-part activity like 跑步 or 打網球, repeat the action word (跑步跑得很快) or move the thing forward (網球打得很好), so the action word still touches 得.

teachingGlossary.meaning: shows how an action is done
ending word for a friendly reply
shows belonging or links a describing word

LESSON_SIX_GRAMMAR_TWO.pattern: Topic or activity + action verb + 得 + performance

discoveryLab.title: Choose the lane to 得
discoveryLab.description: Every lane ends with verb + 得 + performance. The activity’s shape decides what comes before it.

choices.label: Simple verb
choices.note: The action word 跑 goes straight before 得.

choices.label: Repeat the verb
choices.pinyin: Tā pǎobù pǎo de hěn kuài.
choices.note: Say the full activity 跑步, then repeat the action word 跑 before 得.

choices.label: Move object forward
choices.pinyin: Tā wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
choices.note: 網球 becomes the topic, leaving 打 next to 得.

choices.label: Owned activity
choices.pinyin: Tā de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
choices.english: His tennis playing is very good.
choices.note: 他的網球 is the topic; 打 still stands directly before 得.

choices.label: Repair the meter
choices.traditional: 他打得網球很好 → 他網球打得很好
choices.simplified: 他打得网球很好 → 他网球打得很好
choices.pinyin: Tā dǎ de wǎngqiú hěn hǎo → Tā wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo
choices.note: Do not put 網球 after 得.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Protect the core: action word + 得 + performance. Move or repeat the thing when needed.

sentenceSpine.title: Build the unbreakable core
sentenceSpine.description: Three blocks. The middle block is the rule that never changes.
sentenceSpine.positiveEnglish: As for running, it is done very fast.
notes: Right: 跑步 + 跑得 + 很快. Repeat 跑 so the action word touches 得.
Wrong: 跑步 + 得 + 很快. The word 步 cannot attach directly to 得.

discoveryLab.title: Choose the lane to 得
discoveryLab.description: Every lane ends with verb + 得 + performance. The activity’s shape decides what comes before it.

choices.label: Simple verb
choices.note: The action word 跑 goes straight before 得.

choices.label: Repeat the verb
choices.pinyin: Tā pǎobù pǎo de hěn kuài.
choices.note: Say the full activity 跑步, then repeat the action word 跑 before 得.

choices.label: Move object forward
choices.pinyin: Tā wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
choices.note: 網球 becomes the topic, leaving 打 next to 得.

choices.label: Owned activity
choices.pinyin: Tā de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
choices.english: His tennis playing is very good.
choices.note: 他的網球 is the topic; 打 still stands directly before 得.

choices.label: Repair the meter
choices.traditional: 他打得網球很好 → 他網球打得很好
choices.simplified: 他打得网球很好 → 他网球打得很好
choices.pinyin: Tā dǎ de wǎngqiú hěn hǎo → Tā wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo
choices.note: Do not put 網球 after 得.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Protect the core: action word + 得 + performance. Move or repeat the thing when needed.

sentenceSpine.title: Build the unbreakable core
sentenceSpine.description: Three blocks. The middle block is the rule that never changes.
sentenceSpine.positiveEnglish: As for running, it is done very fast.
notes: Right: 跑步 + 跑得 + 很快. Repeat 跑 so the action word touches 得.
Wrong: 跑步 + 得 + 很快. The word 步 cannot attach directly to 得.

items.question: When I say he runs fast, is the middle word 的 or 得?
items.answer: 得. 得 links the action word to how it is done; 的 shows belonging.

items.question: He plays tennis very well. Can I say 他打網球得很好?
items.answer: No — move 網球 in front, or repeat 打, so the action word touches 得: 網球打得很好。

items.question: He drinks a lot. Is it 他喝很多得?
